articles.title: Binance deal gives Circle a boost in stablecoin race with Tether, analysts say
articles.snippet: The five-year deal could strengthen USDC’s reach in emerging markets, though Tether’s liquidity advantage remains hard to dislodge, analysts told CoinDesk.

articles.title: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit
articles.snippet: The Zano blockchain has been restarted at the block height that came immediately before Hard Fork 6, which introduced Gateway Addresses.
